value.rationale: Defines and resolves a natural unconditional scalar minimax one-step reliability question for the published fresh-batch quantile Kaczmarz rule. Provides an exact finite-batch design equation, the sharp 25%-corruption feasibility boundary in this scalar state-relative noise class, and a nontrivial negative loglog amplitude correction to the calibration budget. This is more informative than qualitative rare-outlier failure or routine normalization and is explicitly not asserted to hold in high dimensions.
